---
title: "Publications"
format:
  html:
    toc: false
---

<div id="pubs"></div>

<script>
(async function () {
  const container = document.getElementById("pubs");
  const url = "../publications.json";

  // ---------------- helpers ----------------
  function escapeText(s) { return String(s ?? ""); }

  function normDate(d) {
    const x = String(d ?? "").trim();
    return x.length ? x : "0000-00-00";
  }

  function fmtDate(d) {
    const x = String(d ?? "").trim();
    if (!x) return "";
    const dt = new Date(x);
    if (isNaN(dt.getTime())) return x;
    return dt.toLocaleDateString("en-GB", { day: "2-digit", month: "short", year: "numeric" });
  }

  function compare(a, b, key, dir) {
    let av = a[key] ?? "";
    let bv = b[key] ?? "";
    if (key === "date") {
      av = normDate(av);
      bv = normDate(bv);
    } else {
      av = String(av).toLowerCase();
      bv = String(bv).toLowerCase();
    }
    const cmp = av < bv ? -1 : av > bv ? 1 : 0;
    return dir === "asc" ? cmp : -cmp;
  }

  function normaliseDoiUrl(raw) {
    const s = String(raw ?? "").trim();
    if (!s) return "";
    if (s.startsWith("http://") || s.startsWith("https://")) return s;
    // allow bare DOI like "10.1234/abcd"
    return `https://doi.org/${s}`;
  }

  // Search across all visible fields + DOI URL
  function matchesQuery(p, q) {
    if (!q) return true;
    const hay = [
      p.date, p.title, p.authors, p.category, p.journal, p.keywords, p.doi_url
    ].join(" ").toLowerCase();
    return hay.includes(q);
  }

  try {
    const res = await fetch(url, { cache: "no-store" });
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`Could not load ${url} (${res.status})`);
    const data = await res.json();

    const pubsAll = (data || []).map(d => {
      const kws = Array.isArray(d.keywords) ? d.keywords : [];
      const authorsArr = Array.isArray(d.authors) ? d.authors : [];
      const authorNames = authorsArr.map(author => {
        const parts = author.split(",").map(part => part.trim()).filter(Boolean);
        return parts.length === 2 ? `${parts[1]} ${parts[0]}` : author.trim();
      });
      return ({
        date: d.date || d.published || d.publication_date || "",
        title: d.title || "",
        authors: authorNames.join(", "),
        authorNames,
        category: d.category || "Academic",
        journal: d.venue || d.journal || "",
        outlet_url: d.outlet_url || "",
        keywords: kws.join(", "),
        webnote: d.webnote || "",
        doi_url: normaliseDoiUrl(d.doi_url || d.doi || "")
      });
    });

    if (!pubsAll.length) {
      container.textContent = "No publications found.";
      return;
    }

    let pubsView = pubsAll.slice();
    let sortState = { key: "date", dir: "desc" };
    let query = "";

    // ---------------- UI: search + meta ----------------
    const topbar = document.createElement("div");
    topbar.className = "pubs-topbar";

    const search = document.createElement("input");
    search.className = "pubs-search";
    search.type = "search";
    search.placeholder = "Search title, authors, type, outlet or keywords…";
    search.autocomplete = "off";
    search.spellcheck = false;

    const meta = document.createElement("div");
    meta.className = "pubs-meta";
    meta.textContent = "";

    topbar.appendChild(search);
    topbar.appendChild(meta);

    // ---------------- Table skeleton (NO DOI column) ----------------
    const wrap = document.createElement("div");
    wrap.className = "pubs-table-wrap";

    const table = document.createElement("table");
    table.className = "pubs-table";

    const thead = document.createElement("thead");
    const headRow = document.createElement("tr");

    function makeSortableTh(label, key) {
      const th = document.createElement("th");
      th.className = "pubs-th";
      th.tabIndex = 0;
      th.setAttribute("role", "button");
      th.dataset.key = key;
      th.textContent = label;

      const toggle = () => {
        if (sortState.key === key) {
          sortState.dir = sortState.dir === "asc" ? "desc" : "asc";
        } else {
          sortState.key = key;
          sortState.dir = key === "date" ? "desc" : "asc";
        }
        renderBody();
        renderHeadIndicators();
      };

      th.addEventListener("click", toggle);
      th.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
        if (e.key === "Enter" || e.key === " ") {
          e.preventDefault();
          toggle();
        }
      });

      return th;
    }

    const thDate     = makeSortableTh("Date", "date");
    const thTitle    = makeSortableTh("Title", "title");
    const thAuthors  = makeSortableTh("Author(s)", "authors");
    const thCategory = makeSortableTh("Academic/Policy", "category");
    const thJournal  = makeSortableTh("Outlet", "journal");
    const thKeywords = makeSortableTh("Keywords", "keywords");

    headRow.appendChild(thDate);
    headRow.appendChild(thTitle);
    headRow.appendChild(thAuthors);
    headRow.appendChild(thCategory);
    headRow.appendChild(thJournal);
    headRow.appendChild(thKeywords);

    thead.appendChild(headRow);

    const tbody = document.createElement("tbody");

    table.appendChild(thead);
    table.appendChild(tbody);
    wrap.appendChild(table);

    container.innerHTML = "";
    container.appendChild(topbar);
    container.appendChild(wrap);

    function renderHeadIndicators() {
      const map = new Map([
        [thDate, "Date"],
        [thTitle, "Title"],
        [thAuthors, "Author(s)"],
        [thCategory, "Academic/Policy"],
        [thJournal, "Outlet"],
        [thKeywords, "Keywords"],
      ]);

      for (const [th, base] of map.entries()) {
        const key = th.dataset.key;
        const active = sortState.key === key;
        th.classList.toggle("is-active", active);
        th.textContent = base + (active ? (sortState.dir === "asc" ? " ▲" : " ▼") : "");
      }
    }

    function applyFilter() {
      const q = query.trim().toLowerCase();
      pubsView = pubsAll.filter(p => matchesQuery(p, q));
      meta.textContent = `${pubsView.length} item${pubsView.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}`;
    }

    function renderBody() {
      applyFilter();
      pubsView.sort((a, b) => compare(a, b, sortState.key, sortState.dir));
      tbody.innerHTML = "";

      if (!pubsView.length) {
        const tr = document.createElement("tr");
        const td = document.createElement("td");
        td.colSpan = 7;
        td.className = "pubs-empty";
        td.textContent = "No matches.";
        tr.appendChild(td);
        tbody.appendChild(tr);
        return;
      }

      for (const p of pubsView) {
        const tr = document.createElement("tr");

        // Date
        const tdDate = document.createElement("td");
        tdDate.className = "pubs-date";
        tdDate.dataset.label = "Date";
        tdDate.textContent = fmtDate(p.date);

        // Title — title becomes DOI link if present
        const tdTitle = document.createElement("td");
        tdTitle.className = "pubs-title";
        tdTitle.dataset.label = "Title";

        const doi = String(p.doi_url || "").trim();

        if (doi) {
          const a = document.createElement("a");
          a.href = doi;
          a.target = "_blank";
          a.rel = "noopener";
          a.className = "pubs-title-text pubs-title-link";
          a.textContent = escapeText(p.title);
          tdTitle.appendChild(a);
        } else {
          const span = document.createElement("span");
          span.className = "pubs-title-text";
          span.textContent = escapeText(p.title);
          tdTitle.appendChild(span);
        }

        // Authors
        const tdAuthors = document.createElement("td");
        tdAuthors.className = "pubs-authors";
        tdAuthors.dataset.label = "Author(s)";
        const authorWrap = document.createElement("div");
        authorWrap.className = "pubs-chips";
        for (const author of p.authorNames) {
          const chip = document.createElement("span");
          chip.className = "pubs-chip";
          chip.textContent = author;
          authorWrap.appendChild(chip);
        }
        tdAuthors.appendChild(authorWrap);

        // Academic/policy type
        const tdCategory = document.createElement("td");
        tdCategory.className = "pubs-category";
        tdCategory.dataset.label = "Academic/Policy";
        tdCategory.textContent = escapeText(p.category);

        // Outlet
        const tdJournal = document.createElement("td");
        tdJournal.className = "pubs-journal";
        tdJournal.dataset.label = "Outlet";
        if (p.outlet_url) {
          const a = document.createElement("a");
          a.href = p.outlet_url;
          a.target = "_blank";
          a.rel = "noopener";
          a.textContent = escapeText(p.journal);
          tdJournal.appendChild(a);
        } else {
          tdJournal.textContent = escapeText(p.journal);
        }

        // Keywords (chips)
        const tdKeywords = document.createElement("td");
        tdKeywords.className = "pubs-keywords";
        tdKeywords.dataset.label = "Keywords";

        const kwList = String(p.keywords || "")
          .split(",")
          .map(s => s.trim())
          .filter(Boolean);

        if (kwList.length) {
          const chipWrap = document.createElement("div");
          chipWrap.className = "pubs-chips";
          for (const kw of kwList) {
            const chip = document.createElement("span");
            chip.className = "pubs-chip";
            chip.textContent = kw;
            chipWrap.appendChild(chip);
          }
          tdKeywords.appendChild(chipWrap);
        } else {
          tdKeywords.textContent = "";
        }

        tr.appendChild(tdDate);
        tr.appendChild(tdTitle);
        tr.appendChild(tdAuthors);
        tr.appendChild(tdCategory);
        tr.appendChild(tdJournal);
        tr.appendChild(tdKeywords);

        tbody.appendChild(tr);
      }
    }

    // Wire search
    search.addEventListener("input", () => {
      query = search.value || "";
      renderBody();
      renderHeadIndicators();
    });

    // Initial render
    renderBody();
    renderHeadIndicators();

  } catch (err) {
    container.textContent = `Error: ${err.message}`;
  }
})();
</script>

<style>
/* Search bar */
.pubs-topbar{
  display: flex;
  gap: .75rem;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  margin: .75rem 0 1rem;
}
.pubs-search{
  width: min(520px, 100%);
  padding: .6rem .75rem;
  border-radius: 12px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.12);
  background: rgba(255,255,255,.8);
  outline: none;
}
.pubs-search:focus{
  border-color: rgba(0,0,0,.22);
}
.pubs-meta{
  opacity: .75;
  font-size: .95em;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.pubs-table-wrap {
  overflow-x: auto;
  margin-top: .25rem;
  -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
}

.pubs-table {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
  table-layout: fixed;
}
.pubs-table th, .pubs-table td {
  box-sizing: border-box;
  padding: .75rem .8rem;
  vertical-align: top;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.08);
}
.pubs-table thead th {
  font-weight: 600;
  text-align: left;
  white-space: normal;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
  line-height: 1.2;
}

.pubs-th { cursor: pointer; user-select: none; }
.pubs-th.is-active { text-decoration: underline; }

.pubs-date {
  width: 1%;
  white-space: nowrap;
  font-size: .78em;
}
.pubs-table th:nth-child(1), .pubs-table td:nth-child(1) { width: 12%; }
.pubs-table th:nth-child(2), .pubs-table td:nth-child(2) { width: 20%; }
.pubs-table th:nth-child(3), .pubs-table td:nth-child(3) { width: 17%; }
.pubs-table th:nth-child(4), .pubs-table td:nth-child(4) { width: 17%; }
.pubs-table th:nth-child(4) {
  white-space: nowrap;
  overflow-wrap: normal;
}
.pubs-table th:nth-child(5), .pubs-table td:nth-child(5) { width: 18%; }
.pubs-table th:nth-child(6), .pubs-table td:nth-child(6) { width: 16%; }
.pubs-table td {
  overflow-wrap: normal;
  word-break: normal;
  hyphens: none;
}
.pubs-title-text {
  font-size: .88em;
  font-weight: 600;
}
.pubs-authors { font-size: .92em; opacity: .8; }

/* Title link styling (keeps your “premium” look) */
.pubs-title-link{
  text-decoration: none;
}
.pubs-title-link:hover{
  text-decoration: underline;
}

/* Empty state */
.pubs-empty{
  padding: 1rem .8rem;
  opacity: .8;
}

/* Keyword tags */
.pubs-chips{
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: .35rem;
}
.pubs-chip{
  display: inline-block;
  max-width: 100%;
  padding: .2rem .45rem;
  border: 1px solid rgba(42, 91, 215, .22);
  border-radius: 6px;
  background: rgba(42, 91, 215, .06);
  color: rgba(22, 24, 29, .88);
  font-size: .78em;
  line-height: 1.25;
  white-space: normal;
  overflow-wrap: normal;
  word-break: normal;
}

</style>
